home.title: Indigo Prime Academy | Cambridge school for Grades 7–12 in Bishkek

hero.lead: A school for teenagers in Bishkek where the Cambridge curriculum and the Singapore method turn curiosity into deep understanding, confidence and a clear path to university.

welcome.title: The teenage years are where futures are built
body: Between Grade 7 and Grade 12 a child becomes a young adult. These six years decide how a person thinks, studies and works with others. At Indigo Prime Academy we make them count.

Our pupils follow the internationally recognised Cambridge pathway, learn mathematics and every other subject with the Singapore method, and grow in a friendly, respectful community of girls and boys.

about.title: About Us
about.descr: The story, mission and values of Indigo Prime Academy, a Cambridge school for Grades 7–12 in Bishkek.
about.lead: Indigo Prime Academy is the international high school of the Indigo Academy network in Bishkek, for pupils in Grades 7–12.

story.title: A school made for teenagers
body: Indigo Prime Academy was founded within Indigo Academy, a network of private schools in Bishkek known for strong results and caring teachers.

Families asked for a school that would take their children from the middle grades to university with an international programme, modern teaching and the values they hold dear. Indigo Prime is our answer: a school designed around the needs, interests and ambitions of teenagers.
We combine the Cambridge curriculum with the Singapore method, so that pupils not only know more but also understand more deeply, think independently and learn to work as a team.

mission.d: To educate curious, knowledgeable and responsible young people who are ready for the best universities and for life in a changing world.

vision.d: To be the leading international high school in Kyrgyzstan, where the world’s best methods meet our culture and values.

items.d: asking why, and searching for answers ourselves.
high standards in every lesson and every task.
for elders, for classmates and for every person.
for our learning, our words and our community.
succeeding together and helping others grow.

director.title: Dear parents and pupils
body: Thank you for your interest in Indigo Prime Academy. Choosing a school for the teenage years is one of the most important decisions a family makes.

Our teachers know every pupil by name. They notice when a pupil is ready for a bigger challenge and when they need a little more support. We measure success not only in exam results but in the confidence with which our pupils speak, the questions they ask and the goals they dare to set.
I warmly invite you to visit us, to see a Singapore-method lesson and to talk with our team. Our doors are always open.

coed.title: Girls and boys learning together
coed.body: Indigo Prime is a mixed school. Teenagers learn side by side, just as they will at university and at work, in an atmosphere of mutual respect and clear rules.

items.d: Mixed teams bring different ideas to every project and discussion.
A clear code of conduct and attentive class teachers keep the school calm and safe.
Every pupil leads, presents and takes part, whatever the subject.
Pupils leave school used to working with everyone, as they will in higher education.

network.title: Part of Indigo Academy
network.body: Indigo Prime Academy shares the experience, methods and teacher development programmes of the Indigo Academy network of schools in Bishkek.

academics.title: Programmes
academics.descr: The Cambridge pathway at Indigo Prime Academy: Lower Secondary, IGCSE and A Level for Grades 7–12.
academics.lead: From Grade 7 to Grade 12 our pupils follow the Cambridge pathway, step by step, towards internationally recognised qualifications and university.

overview.title: The Cambridge pathway at Indigo Prime
overview.body: Three stages build on one another. Each stage has clear learning goals, regular assessment and a final Cambridge exam.

items.d: Strong foundations in English, mathematics and science, and the habits of independent study.
items.long: Pupils strengthen the core subjects and learn how to study: planning, note-taking, research and presenting. The stage ends with Cambridge Checkpoint tests that show each pupil’s strengths.
list: English, mathematics and science to Cambridge standards
Cambridge Checkpoint at the end of the stage

items.d: The world’s most popular international qualification for 14 to 16 year olds.
items.long: Pupils choose their IGCSE subjects with the help of teachers and parents. Lessons focus on deep understanding, laboratory work, essay writing and exam skills.

items.d: Focused, university-level study in the subjects each pupil chooses.
items.long: In the final two years pupils specialise in three or four subjects at AS and A Level. A Level results are accepted by universities around the world.
list: Preparation for IELTS / SAT and the ORT

subjects.title: What our pupils study

items.d: Short checks in lessons and end-of-unit tests to Cambridge standards.
Pupils know what they do well and what to improve next.
Reports and open conversations with families every term.
Olympiad groups and extra classes for pupils ready for more.

method.title: Cambridge & Singapore
method.descr: How Indigo Prime Academy combines the Cambridge curriculum with the Singapore method of teaching.
method.lead: Cambridge sets the international standard of what pupils learn. The Singapore method decides how they learn it: actively, together and with real understanding.

cambridge.title: An international standard for every subject
body: Cambridge International Education is part of the University of Cambridge. Its programmes and exams are used by schools in more than 160 countries and accepted by universities around the world.
Every subject has a clear curriculum framework for each year. Teachers plan lessons against these goals, and pupils take externally marked exams at the end of Lower Secondary, IGCSE and A Level.
The programme values thinking skills as much as knowledge: analysing, explaining, experimenting and writing clearly.

items: Confident in working with information and ideas
Reflective, able to develop their ability to learn
Innovative and ready for new challenges

singapore.title: Mathematics you can see and understand
singapore.body: Singapore is among the world leaders in international studies of mathematics. Its method moves every new idea through three steps, so that pupils truly understand before they practise.

cpa.d: Pupils first explore an idea with real objects: cubes, counters, measuring tools, paper models.
Then they draw the problem. The famous bar model turns a word problem into a clear picture.
Only then do they move to numbers and symbols, now with a solid understanding behind them.

structures.title: Learning structures that involve every pupil
structures.body: Beyond mathematics, our teachers use Singapore collaborative learning structures in all subjects. Nobody sits quietly at the back: everyone thinks, speaks and helps.

items.d: Pupils explain ideas to a partner, check each other and take turns answering.
Small mixed teams solve problems together, each pupil with a clear role.
A pause before answering so that every pupil, not only the fastest, has time to think.
Structured turn-taking means every pupil takes part, every lesson.
The lesson begins with a problem or question linked to life.
Pupils try ideas with objects, drawings or experiments.
Pairs and teams compare methods and explain their thinking.
Focused practice, from simple to challenging tasks.
Pupils check what they have learned and what comes next.

A short assessment in English and mathematics, and a friendly interview.
Bring the documents from the list below to the school office.
Sign the agreement, receive the uniform and timetable, and get ready for the first day.

items.a: Indigo Prime Academy teaches Grades 7 to 12. Pupils usually join in Grade 7, but transfers to other grades are possible when places are available.
Yes. Pupils complete a short assessment in English and mathematics and have a friendly interview, so that we can plan the right support.

items.q: My child’s English is not strong yet. Can they still apply?
items.a: Yes. We look at each pupil’s potential. New pupils can receive extra English support to help them follow Cambridge lessons.

items.q: Is the school for girls and boys?
items.a: Yes, Indigo Prime Academy is a co-educational school. Girls and boys learn together.
It is a way of teaching where new ideas move from objects to pictures to symbols, and where pupils work actively in pairs and teams in every lesson.
